title: In dry Gujarat, spurious booze kills 6 at party thrown by cop; 25 in hospital

title: Microsoft AI CMO Andra Mallard leaves after just 6 months

title: Manhattan replants Broadway medians with native species for birds and bees
content: Manhattan’s Broadway medians are being replanted with native Northeast species under a long-term project by the Broadway Mall Association. The Great Green Way covers five miles of Broadway and aims to connect 83 green malls into a corridor that can support birds, bees and other wildlife. Twelve malls have been restored so far, with more planting planned through 2026.

title: IIT Delhi engineer built India’s sonar in 1971: How his MIMO changed 4G, 5G
content: Indian engineer and scientist Arogyaswami Paulraj’s journey from developing indigenous sonar for the Indian Navy to pioneering MIMO technology illustrates the far-reaching impact of research. His APSOH sonar project strengthened India’s underwater detection capabilities, while his later work at Stanford transformed wireless communication. MIMO became a foundation of high-speed connectivity used in 4G, 5G and Wi-Fi. Paulraj’s career highlights how persistence, fundamental research and unexpected discoveries can produce technologies that reshape everyday life.

title: Ex-Meta employee claims it had a ‘don’t ask, don’t tell’ policy on child safety issues

title: US Army eyes mobile K9 howitzer to replace M777; India too shifts towards wheeled artillery

content: the messages came on the birth anniversary of their father, former prime minister Rajiv Gandhi . both Rahul and Priyanka will release their memoir 'Belonging: a Journey of Love' the messages reflect the relationship of their parents and the personal losses they endured .

title: NALSAR row sparks fresh protest: Lawyers demand resignation of BCI chief Manan Mishra
content: lawyers protest outside the bar Council of India office demanding resignation of chairman Manan Kumar Mishra . the protest came days after the council’s now-withdrawn order targeting the enrolment of NALSAR University’s graduating batch drew criticism from sections of the legal fraternity .

title: Rajdhani waits as 90 jumbos cross rail tracks
content: dibrugarh-Delhi Rajdhani Express stopped for large elephant herd . herd was returning from west Karbi Anglong to Lumding Reserve Forest . forest range officer says she was heading to mylo, an elephant corridor .

title: Former Congress MP Sajjan Kumar, convicted in 1984 anti-Sikh riots case, dies at 80
